name: Basic CCI RSI
summary: This EA generates trading signals based on the combined readings of CCI and RSI indicators. It opens buy positions when both indicators suggest oversold conditions and sell positions when they indicate overbought conditions. The strategy is a classic dual-oscillator momentum reversal system with fixed lot sizing and stop-loss/take-profit management.
summary_zh: 该EA基于CCI和RSI两个振荡指标的组合读数生成交易信号。当两个指标同时显示超卖状态时开多仓，当两个指标同时显示超买状态时开空仓。这是一个经典的双振荡器动量反转系统，采用固定手数和止损/止盈管理。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于CCI（商品通道指数）和RSI（相对强弱指数）两个动量振荡器的组合信号，属于动量反转类策略。入场条件为：当CCI跌破超卖阈值且RSI也低于超卖阈值时做多，当CCI突破超买阈值且RSI也高于超买阈值时做空。出场条件依赖预设的止损和止盈水平，属于固定点数出场方式。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，未根据账户资金或波动性进行动态调整。资金管理方面缺乏风险比例计算，止损设置虽然有但未考虑市场波动性（如ATR）进行自适应调整。整体策略逻辑简单直接，适合初学者理解，但缺乏足够的过滤条件和市场状态判断机制。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on combined signals from CCI (Commodity Channel Index) and RSI (Relative Strength Index) oscillators, falling under the momentum reversal category. Entry conditions require both indicators to confirm: a buy signal triggers when CCI drops below its oversold threshold and RSI also falls below its oversold level, while a sell signal triggers when CCI exceeds its overbought threshold and RSI also rises above its overbought level. Exit conditions rely on predetermined fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels without any trailing or dynamic adjustment mechanism. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without any account equity or volatility-based dynamic calculation. Money management lacks risk percentage sizing and the stop-loss settings do not adapt to market volatility using tools like ATR. Overall the strategy logic is straightforward and beginner-friendly but lacks sufficient filtering conditions and market regime detection mechanisms.
pros: 双指标确认机制减少了虚假信号，比单一指标策略更可靠
策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和调试，适合学习参考
使用固定的止损和止盈，风险敞口有明确的上限控制
pros_en: Dual-indicator confirmation reduces false signals compared to single-indicator strategies
Strategy logic is simple and clear, easy to understand and debug, suitable for learning reference
Fixed stop-loss and take-profit provide a defined cap on risk exposure per trade
cons: 固定手数不根据账户资金动态调整，无法适应不同规模账户
缺乏市场趋势过滤，在强趋势行情中容易产生逆势交易
没有新K线检查机制，可能同一根K线内重复开仓造成过度交易
cons_en: Fixed lot sizing does not dynamically adjust based on account equity, unsuitable for varying account sizes
Lacks trend filter, prone to counter-trend trades during strong trending markets
No new bar check mechanism, potentially opening multiple positions within the same bar causing overtrading
improvements: 加入ATR动态止损止盈，使风险管理适应市场波动性
增加趋势过滤器（如移动平均线），避免在强趋势中逆势交易
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit to adapt risk management to market volatility
Add a trend filter (e.g., moving average) to avoid counter-trend entries during strong trends

risk_points: 缺乏新K线检查可能导致同一根K线内重复开仓
固定手数未考虑账户资金比例，大资金下风险集中
risk_points_en: No new bar check may cause duplicate position opening within the same bar
Fixed lot sizing ignores account equity ratio, concentrating risk with larger accounts

summary_en: This EA generates trading signals based on the combined readings of CCI and RSI indicators. It opens buy positions when both indicators suggest oversold conditions and sell positions when they indicate overbought conditions. The strategy is a classic dual-oscillator momentum reversal system with fixed lot sizing and stop-loss/take-profit management.
